items.title: Real Base Progress - in Summer! | Vintage Story Co-op with Shack
items.description: See the bottom of the description for the mod list 👇 For my main channel head to https://youtube.com/splitsie Join the discord at: https://discord.gg/aRKrshT If you'd like to support my content you can join the channel or head to https://patreon.com/splitsie For merchandise head to https://zebramonkeys.redbubble.com or https://splitsie.myspreadshop.com/ Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/splitsie and for the schedule head to https://twitch.tv/splitsie/schedule (displays in your local timezone) For business contacts please use the email in the contact info. For clarity, I will not support any cryptocurrency, NFT or other similar product through a paid promotion. Any such offers will be marked as spam. Alternate Offhand Penalty - This is a stream, we need to be able to see and not get too penalised for holding a torch BedSpawn - It's just more fun to wake up at home when you die BetterRuins - it's in there, but probably not working. I think I've seen it spawn something once, so I left it in BloodTrail - makes hunting a bit more fun Borderless Window Fix - so that we can run in borderless windowed without the taskbar being visible Butchering - adds some extra consideration for hunting trips and a bit more interest in processing Shack's kills making it more fun Carry On - it's just good Chiseled Block Retention - because it's nice to be able to make our own windows ChiselTools - At some point I'll learn how to use these to speed up the custom builds Coffee and Tea - because something needs to fuel shack CommonLib - one of the mods needs it, can't remember which Emotes - Because they're fun FreeRoamCam - for thumbnails Functional Miner Belt and Lantern - because it's nice to see what we're streaming (if we ever make one) HUD Clock - handy info in top left of screen Immersive Corpse Drop - No more closing the inventory of a drifter that wasn't holding anything anyway Lower Grass Overlay - to make the grass look better with the terrain slabs mod Photomode - because freeroamcam wasn't working for reasons I couldn't figure out, but if I can get it working it's less restrictive than this one Pickup Baby Animals Fork - because as hilarious as it was, the bola and rope was extra silly Place On Slabs - again to make things look better with terrain slabs PlayerCorpseForked - death runs are fine, but I like knowing that I will actually get my stuff back if I get there (both of these mods are in, not sure if that's on purpose at the time of writing) ProspectTogether - Once prospecting begins it'll be super handy to have that info shared RealSmoke - who doesn't want to need a proper chimney? Shipwright - boats! boats! boats! Smithing Plus - I'm a terrible smith so it's nice to have the ability to get some of the little parts back during smithing, as well as the extra controls Tallow Candle - Shack doesn't like bees but he does like hunting and we both like lanterns Terrain Slabs - I really like the smoother terrain Terra Prety 7.10.2 - As much as it makes the game easier in some respects, the vistas and views are just so much more enjoyable that it feels worth it VSAirships - because Airships! VSInstruments Redux - thought it might be cool during winter to have some music to make VS Roofing - Having cool roofs makes cool builds Wanderer's Sketchbook - I thought it might be nice to have a very personalisable notebook Watersheds 6.4.3 - cool rivers are cool ZoomButton - so we can see things and show them on stream

Alternate Offhand Penalty - This is a stream, we need to be able to see and not get too penalised for holding a torch BedSpawn - It's just more fun to wake up at home when you die BetterRuins - it's in there, but probably not working. I think I've seen it spawn something once, so I left it in BloodTrail - makes hunting a bit more fun Borderless Window Fix - so that we can run in borderless windowed without the taskbar being visible Butchering - adds some extra consideration for hunting trips and a bit more interest in processing Shack's kills making it more fun Carry On - it's just good Chiseled Block Retention - because it's nice to be able to make our own windows ChiselTools - At some point I'll learn how to use these to speed up the custom builds Coffee and Tea - because something needs to fuel shack CommonLib - one of the mods needs it, can't remember which Emotes - Because they're fun FreeRoamCam - for thumbnails Functional Miner Belt and Lantern - because it's nice to see what we're streaming (if we ever make one) HUD Clock - handy info in top left of screen Immersive Corpse Drop - No more closing the inventory of a drifter that wasn't holding anything anyway Lower Grass Overlay - to make the grass look better with the terrain slabs mod Photomode - because freeroamcam wasn't working for reasons I couldn't figure out, but if I can get it working it's less restrictive than this one Pickup Baby Animals Fork - because as hilarious as it was, the bola and rope was extra silly Place On Slabs - again to make things look better with terrain slabs PlayerCorpseForked - death runs are fine, but I like knowing that I will actually get my stuff back if I get there (both of these mods are in, not sure if that's on purpose at the time of writing) ProspectTogether - Once prospecting begins it'll be super handy to have that info shared RealSmoke - who doesn't want to need a proper chimney? Shipwright - boats! boats! boats! Smithing Plus - I'm a terrible smith so it's nice to have the ability to get some of the little parts back during smithing, as well as the extra controls Tallow Candle - Shack doesn't like bees but he does like hunting and we both like lanterns Terrain Slabs - I really like the smoother terrain Terra Prety 7.10.2 - As much as it makes the game easier in some respects, the vistas and views are just so much more enjoyable that it feels worth it VSAirships - because Airships! VSInstruments Redux - thought it might be cool during winter to have some music to make VS Roofing - Having cool roofs makes cool builds Wanderer's Sketchbook - I thought it might be nice to have a very personalisable notebook Watersheds 6.4.3 - cool rivers are cool ZoomButton - so we can see things and show them on stream

items.description: See the bottom of the description for the mod list 👇 For my main channel head to https://youtube.com/splitsie Join the discord at: https://discord.gg/aRKrshT If you'd like to support my content you can join the channel or head to https://patreon.com/splitsie For merchandise head to https://zebramonkeys.redbubble.com or https://splitsie.myspreadshop.com/ Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/splitsie and for the schedule head to https://twitch.tv/splitsie/schedule (displays in your local timezone) For business contacts please use the email in the contact info. For clarity, I will not support any cryptocurrency, NFT or other similar product through a paid promotion. Any such offers will be marked as spam. Alternate Offhand Penalty - This is a stream, we need to be able to see and not get too penalised for holding a torch BedSpawn - It's just more fun to wake up at home when you die BetterRuins - it's in there, but probably not working. I think I've seen it spawn something once, so I left it in BloodTrail - makes hunting a bit more fun Borderless Window Fix - so that we can run in borderless windowed without the taskbar being visible Butchering - adds some extra consideration for hunting trips and a bit more interest in processing Shack's kills making it more fun Carry On - it's just good Chiseled Block Retention - because it's nice to be able to make our own windows ChiselTools - At some point I'll learn how to use these to speed up the custom builds Coffee and Tea - because something needs to fuel shack CommonLib - one of the mods needs it, can't remember which Emotes - Because they're fun FreeRoamCam - for thumbnails Functional Miner Belt and Lantern - because it's nice to see what we're streaming (if we ever make one) HUD Clock - handy info in top left of screen Immersive Corpse Drop - No more closing the inventory of a drifter that wasn't holding anything anyway Lower Grass Overlay - to make the grass look better with the terrain slabs mod Photomode - because freeroamcam wasn't working for reasons I couldn't figure out, but if I can get it working it's less restrictive than this one Pickup Baby Animals Fork - because as hilarious as it was, the bola and rope was extra silly Place On Slabs - again to make things look better with terrain slabs PlayerCorpseForked - death runs are fine, but I like knowing that I will actually get my stuff back if I get there (both of these mods are in, not sure if that's on purpose at the time of writing) ProspectTogether - Once prospecting begins it'll be super handy to have that info shared RealSmoke - who doesn't want to need a proper chimney? Shipwright - boats! boats! boats! Smithing Plus - I'm a terrible smith so it's nice to have the ability to get some of the little parts back during smithing, as well as the extra controls Tallow Candle - Shack doesn't like bees but he does like hunting and we both like lanterns Terrain Slabs - I really like the smoother terrain Terra Prety 7.10.2 - As much as it makes the game easier in some respects, the vistas and views are just so much more enjoyable that it feels worth it VSAirships - because Airships! VSInstruments Redux - thought it might be cool during winter to have some music to make VS Roofing - Having cool roofs makes cool builds Wanderer's Sketchbook - I thought it might be nice to have a very personalisable notebook Watersheds 6.4.3 - cool rivers are cool ZoomButton - so we can see things and show them on stream

items.title: The Upheaval Settles, Is it Time for Exploration? | Vintage Story Co-op with Shack
items.description: See the bottom of the description for the mod list 👇 For my main channel head to https://youtube.com/splitsie Join the discord at: https://discord.gg/aRKrshT If you'd like to support my content you can join the channel or head to https://patreon.com/splitsie For merchandise head to https://zebramonkeys.redbubble.com or https://splitsie.myspreadshop.com/ Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/splitsie and for the schedule head to https://twitch.tv/splitsie/schedule (displays in your local timezone) For business contacts please use the email in the contact info. For clarity, I will not support any cryptocurrency, NFT or other similar product through a paid promotion. Any such offers will be marked as spam. Alternate Offhand Penalty - This is a stream, we need to be able to see and not get too penalised for holding a torch BedSpawn - It's just more fun to wake up at home when you die BetterRuins - it's in there, but probably not working. I think I've seen it spawn something once, so I left it in BloodTrail - makes hunting a bit more fun Borderless Window Fix - so that we can run in borderless windowed without the taskbar being visible Butchering - adds some extra consideration for hunting trips and a bit more interest in processing Shack's kills making it more fun Carry On - it's just good Chiseled Block Retention - because it's nice to be able to make our own windows ChiselTools - At some point I'll learn how to use these to speed up the custom builds Coffee and Tea - because something needs to fuel shack CommonLib - one of the mods needs it, can't remember which Emotes - Because they're fun FreeRoamCam - for thumbnails Functional Miner Belt and Lantern - because it's nice to see what we're streaming (if we ever make one) HUD Clock - handy info in top left of screen Immersive Corpse Drop - No more closing the inventory of a drifter that wasn't holding anything anyway Lower Grass Overlay - to make the grass look better with the terrain slabs mod Photomode - because freeroamcam wasn't working for reasons I couldn't figure out, but if I can get it working it's less restrictive than this one Pickup Baby Animals Fork - because as hilarious as it was, the bola and rope was extra silly Place On Slabs - again to make things look better with terrain slabs PlayerCorpseForked - death runs are fine, but I like knowing that I will actually get my stuff back if I get there (both of these mods are in, not sure if that's on purpose at the time of writing) ProspectTogether - Once prospecting begins it'll be super handy to have that info shared RealSmoke - who doesn't want to need a proper chimney? Shipwright - boats! boats! boats! Smithing Plus - I'm a terrible smith so it's nice to have the ability to get some of the little parts back during smithing, as well as the extra controls Tallow Candle - Shack doesn't like bees but he does like hunting and we both like lanterns Terrain Slabs - I really like the smoother terrain Terra Prety 7.10.2 - As much as it makes the game easier in some respects, the vistas and views are just so much more enjoyable that it feels worth it VSAirships - because Airships! VSInstruments Redux - thought it might be cool during winter to have some music to make VS Roofing - Having cool roofs makes cool builds Wanderer's Sketchbook - I thought it might be nice to have a very personalisable notebook Watersheds 6.4.3 - cool rivers are cool ZoomButton - so we can see things and show them on stream
